title: Tahoe Coastal Self-Guided E-Bike Tour - Full-Day | World Famous East Shore Trail
blurb:
Imagine: a FULL day soaking up the sun at stunning beaches and discovering hidden shoreline gems, all on two wheels! Experience the breathtaking majesty of Lake Tahoe like NEVER before, with the incredible freedom and convenience only a bike can provide! And guess what? Every single one of our bikes comes equipped with a handy front bag and a rack with bungees, so you can bring EVERYTHING you need for an epic day of exploration! Let's ride!

Our amazing team is bursting with excitement to show you all the incredible sights and sounds along your Lake Tahoe journey! Hold onto your hats, because we’re hitting the legendary Lake Tahoe East Shore Trail, leading us straight to the breathtaking Sand Harbor State Park! Get ready to dive into a world of delicious food, sun-kissed beaches, magical walking trails, & endless water adventures! This isn’t just a trip, it’s a THRILL RIDE of pure, unadulterated FUN!

Please Note: Minimum Age is 13+. Riders under Age 18 must be accompanied by a Parent
